Annie R: RCA for yesterday's degraded routing incident is published: <https://internal.redwood.com/rcas/2337601234|RCA doc>. TL;DR: root cause was a cache eviction bug + rollout timing. Key actions below, please ack.
Mike T: reading now. can you paste the short owner list? I might be able to help on batching config.
Annie R: owners in the doc but quick list: Sarah L (cache fix), Leo K (deploy & rollout), Jordan P (monitoring + alert tuning), Mike T (batching suggestion), Ops will verify mitigation runbook. ETA for owners to ack: EOD today.
Sarah L: acked. starting a branch with the cache patch, will push a PR tonight. assigning code review to Leo.
Leo K: acked. I'll coordinate the canary and rollback window. prefer a small canary 5% for 2h then ramp if green.
Jordan P: adding new alert thresholds to reduce noise, will include synthetic checks for prefix cache hits.
ops-oncall: confirmed runbook tested once; will run mitigation after the PR merges. tagging infra for extra capacity during rollout.
Mike T: quick note on batching: we should reduce max batch latency to 30ms in the hot path for the next 24h to avoid tail amplification. I'll open a config change PR and link it here.
Annie R: thanks — two follow-ups: 1) Office hours tomorrow 10:30-11:30 PT to walk through the RCA and answer questions (calendar invite sent). 2) Priority tracker + action items are in the doc under "Next Steps" — please update the owner/status there when you make progress.
Jordan P: can office hours be recorded? out-of-region folks will need it.
incident-bot: Meeting created: "RCA Office Hours - degraded routing" 2026-03-24T10:30:00 PT. Recording enabled.
Sarah L: recording enabled is perfect. I'll demo the cache repro locally.
Annie R: timeline: short-term mitigation in next 24-48h. medium-term fix (cache patch + monitor) target by end of sprint (Apr 6). follow-up checkpoint on Apr 9 to verify regressions and SLA impact metrics. please add any blockers to the doc.
Mike T: added batching PR link in doc. ping me if you need a quick pairing session.
Leo K: will update the rollout checklist and post final canary times here before starting.
Annie R: appreciate the quick responses. if you haven't acked ownership in the doc, please do so now. we'll close the loop after the Apr 9 checkpoint. :thumbsup:
